BEGIN;
LOCK TABLE student_onboarding_path_admission_operation IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE;
LOCK TABLE student_onboarding_path_admission IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE;
DO $$ BEGIN
 IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM student_onboarding_path_admission) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM student_onboarding_path_admission_operation) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'cannot roll back student onboarding path admission after evidence exists';
 END IF;
END $$;
DROP TABLE student_onboarding_path_admission_operation;
DROP TABLE student_onboarding_path_admission;
DROP FUNCTION student_onboarding_path_admission_delete_guard();
DROP FUNCTION student_onboarding_path_admission_update_guard();
COMMIT;
